<b>Choir Cloaks</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
16 Choir Cloaks are required to complete the <i>[[Cloaks of the Choir]]</i> Wish, given out by the [[Wishwalls|Wishwall]] at [[Choral Chambers#Sub-area: Songclave|Songclave]].

== How to Acquire ==
Choir cloaks can be obtained from the corpses of slain [[Choir Pouncer]]s, [[Choir Hornhead]]s, [[Choir Flyer|Choir Flyers]], and [[Choir Elder]]s in [[Choral Chambers]] while <i>Cloaks of the Choir</i> is active. [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can carry up to 16 cloaks, after which they will no longer drop from defeated Choirbug enemies.
